findings.comment: Site plan shows curbside trash collection note but does not identify or depict a dumpster/refuse collection area with dimensions, setback distances, or maneuvering area for collection vehicles on the site plan. No dumpster enclosure location, size, or collection vehicle turning radius is shown; therefore, compliance with TCM 9.4.1.C (location off main access/parking aisles away from pedestrian corridors) and TCM 9.4.1.D (maneuvering contained on-site without public ROW use) cannot be verified.

Site plan does not clearly establish whether trash service is on-site, off-site, or shared. Curbside collection note does not clarify trash container storage location or service methodology. No Unified Development Agreement, PDRD-accepted arrangement, or shared trash agreement is referenced or provided in the submittal.

applicableAreas: site plan - trash collection coordination with parking and pedestrian areas
findings.comment: Site plan does not demonstrate that trash pickup and delivery will avoid intermixing with concurrent site operations. Without a shown or designated trash collection facility location, compliance with TCM 9.4.1.C requirement that trash collection be located off main access/parking aisles and away from pedestrian corridors cannot be verified.

Multi-Family Recycling Plan Form required by Austin City Code Chapter 15-6 is not completed, submitted, or referenced in the site plan set. While the cover sheet notes that compliance with the Commercial and Multi-Family Recycling Ordinance is mandatory, no completed form documentation is provided.

No designated on-site storage area for recycling containers is shown on the site plan. For a 39-unit multi-family development, space must be provided for storage of recycling receptacles and collection containers as required by the City's recycling ordinance.

Recycling equipment location is not shown on the site plan. For a multi-family development, if recycling facilities are located outside the building (which appears to be the case), their location must be clearly identified on the site plan.

Multi-building site (8 buildings) does not clarify the number and location of dumpsters or trash containers serving each building. Plan does not demonstrate that a single shared facility (if that is the intent) is adequate for all buildings, nor does it establish per-building trash assignments.

applicableAreas: site plan - dumpster/trash location relative to SF-3 adjacent property
findings.comment: Site is adjacent to SF-3 property (triggering property per Article 10 Compatibility Standards). No dumpster or permanently placed refuse receptacle is shown on the site plan; therefore, the minimum 20-foot setback distance from the SF-3 property cannot be measured or verified.

The required Compatibility section note is missing from the site plan cover sheet. Standard Austin site plans must include the note: 'All dumpsters and any permanently placed refuse receptacles will be located at a minimum of twenty (20) feet from a property used or zoned as SF-5 or more restrictive.' This note is required on all sites as part of standard submittal requirements.

Site is subject to Article 10 Compatibility Standards (MF-2 zoning adjacent to SF-3 triggering property within 75 feet). No concrete slab for a refuse receptacle is depicted on the site plan; therefore, compliance with the 15-foot setback requirement from the triggering property cannot be verified.

Site is adjacent to SF-3 residential property. No refuse collection area is depicted on the site plan; therefore, compliance with screening requirements to prevent visibility at the shared property line (Article 10, LDC § 25-2-1063(E)(4)) and general service area screening (LDC § 25-2-1006(C)) cannot be verified.

codeCitations: General Site Plan Notes (Fire Department section)
findings.comment: The required Fire Department note regarding commercial dumpsters and containers is missing from the site plan cover sheet. The note 'Commercial dumpsters and containers ≥ 1.5 cubic yards shall not be stored within 10 feet of openings, combustible walls, or combustible eave lines' is required in the Fire Department section of all Austin site plans.

applicableAreas: site plan - trash collection maneuvering area
findings.comment: No specific maneuvering area for garbage collection vehicles is labeled or identified on the site plan. Without a designated dumpster location or marked collection vehicle turning radius and maneuvering area, compliance with TCM 9.4.1.D (maneuvering fully contained on-site without use of public ROW) cannot be verified.
